{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Define the valid population: converted AND age not -1
valid_converted = (df['converted'] == 1) & (df['customer_age'] != -1)

# Compute the number of valid converted customers
num_valid_converted = valid_converted.sum()
print(f'Number of converted customers with valid age: {num_valid_converted}')

# Compute mean age for valid converted customers
mean_age = df.loc[valid_converted, 'customer_age'].mean()
print(f'Mean age of converted customers with valid age: {mean_age}')

# Round to two decimal places for reporting
mean_age_rounded = round(mean_age, 2)
print(f'Rounded mean age: {mean_age_rounded}')"}
